summary: Workflows occasionally get stuck with 'running' status on Temporal deployed on Alibaba Cloud SAE, occurring approximately once per 100 workflow executions during batch testing.
userImpact: Workflows intermittently fail to complete, remaining stuck in running state, causing workflow execution failures and requiring manual intervention.
keyQuote: the workflow gets stuck, and the status remains as "running". Of course, this happens roughly once in every 100 cases
